svg.title: Guarantee — Sequential Multi-Agent Architecture
svg.desc: A DOCX contract enters the Lumen Platform Task Executor API. A sequential root controller runs clause extraction, legal intent, fact extraction, classification and 13-point review in that order, carrying original contract and prior outputs forward. Specialists access Gemini 3.8 Flash through R2D2. R2D2 is inside Citi Network and outside Lumen; Gemini is in External Cloud. The API returns a JSON-encoded conditions string, classification rationale and CSV evidence files for clauses, legal intent and facts.
svg.text: Lumen Platform • five specialist stages • governed model access through R2D2
Runs specialists in order; carries the contract and prior outputs forward.
Agent / model settings • clause / intent / fact dictionaries
CSV evidence files: clauses, legal intent and facts
Evidence returned in API state • quoted support and actions
Review outputs include CSV evidence files and JSON assessments; the coordinator runs the five specialists in order.
